slice: D2 - outdoor, garden, pets and cars

ideas.name: Roof-Window Cat Perch
ideas.concept: Flat-pack perch with clamp-on rails sized for sloped roof-window sills and standard sills, daylight-optimised, no drilling.
ideas.target_customer: Renters in attic/top-floor flats in SE/DK with indoor cats
ideas.problem_solved: Indoor cats need elevated daylight viewing; most perches fit vertical windows only.
ideas.trend_evidence: Euromonitor (Nov 2025) reports feline favouritism driving pet care growth in Western Europe; FEDIAF-citing trade coverage says cats outnumber dogs in Europe. Renter window-perch demand seen only via retailer/Reddit content, no hard sales data; roof-window niche is my own inference.
ideas.defensibility_angle: VELUX-informed fit to roof-window geometry and daylight; design registration; dimension-specific fit guarantee.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 9-12 (laser-cut birch ply + aluminium clamp, no steel mould)
ideas.tooling_needed: CNC/laser cutting files, small bracket die or stock extrusion

ideas.name: Refillable Silvervine Cat Toy System
ideas.concept: Durable Nordic-design fabric toys with a replaceable silvervine/catnip insert; sell refill pouches by subscription.
ideas.problem_solved: Bored indoor cats; toys go stale and get thrown away.
ideas.trend_evidence: Euromonitor says cats drive pet product growth; trade commentary says cat owners are underserved versus dog ranges. No verified data on refill-toy demand.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Brand and design plus refill ecosystem and proprietary insert format; recurring revenue.

ideas.name: Senior Dog Paw-Grip Stair and Floor Kit
ideas.concept: Non-slip adhesive tread strips and runner mat sized for home stairs and car boot sills, styled for living rooms (comfort, not medical).
ideas.target_customer: Owners of older dogs in flats and houses with hard floors
ideas.problem_solved: Slippery floors and stairs for ageing dogs; existing mats are ugly.
ideas.trend_evidence: Trade press covers senior-pet accessories and humanisation; market-report claims on mobility aids are unverified and Europe data thin.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Brand and design; must avoid medical claims, position as home comfort.

ideas.name: Nordic Native Balcony Pollinator Seed Kit
ideas.concept: Seed mix plus compostable pot for balcony planters, curated for SE/DK native pollinators, with seasonal refill packs.
ideas.problem_solved: Easy low-skill biodiversity for small spaces, repeat each season.
ideas.trend_evidence: Trade pieces note container gardening among renters and insect hotel/urban wildlife trends in Europe; no reliable EU sales figures found. EU seed-marketing rules need checking.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Localised native mixes, brand and seasonal subscription.

ideas.name: No-Drill Balcony Rail Planter Clamp
ideas.concept: Tool-free clamp system holding standard planters on common Nordic balcony railings, wind-rated and rental-friendly.
ideas.target_customer: Renters in flats with balcony railings
ideas.problem_solved: Cannot drill into rented balconies; planters fall in wind.
ideas.trend_evidence: Renter/portable-garden demand described in trade sources; European urban balcony planter opportunity noted. No volume data; wind-safety is the claim to test.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Building-industry fixing know-how, design registration, rail-profile fit chart.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 8-11 (stamped steel/aluminium; check bracket tooling under EUR 2k)
ideas.tooling_needed: Simple stamping/bending die, possibly stock extrusion

ideas.name: Window-Mount Bird and Insect Habitat Set
ideas.concept: Flat-pack FSC wood feeder plus bee/insect hotel mounting to window or railing, with refillable seed/food pouches.
ideas.target_customer: Apartment dwellers wanting nature at home, gift buyers
ideas.trend_evidence: Retail coverage of a bird-feeder boom and urban wildlife products for apartments; elho has a biodiversity range, so supply exists. Strongest figure was a 2020 spike, not current trend.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design and refill consumables; weak copy-resistance.

ideas.name: Nordic Wet-Weather Dog Boot Mat
ideas.concept: Super-absorbent, machine-washable mat that fixes into car boot and hallway, with paw-wipe zone, in muted Scandinavian styling.
ideas.target_customer: Dog owners in SE/DK with car and rainy-season mud
ideas.problem_solved: Wet and muddy dogs in cars and flats.
ideas.trend_evidence: Crash-tested car pet gear from Thule and others shows premium demand, indicating crowded top end. No verified European demand figures; low-confidence.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design and fit by car model; weak otherwise.
